entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 7978 of 2022

Applicant :- Pawan Kumar Gupta S/O Late Shitla Prasad Gupta
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Sery. Home, Lko.

Counsel for Applicant :- Narendra Gupta,Pankaj Gupta
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.
Supplementary affidavit filed by the applicant today in Court is taken on record.

2. Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.
3.
The FIR in question was lodged alleging that the daughter of the informant died on account of harassment for non-payment of demand of dowry.
The marriage took place around five years ago.

4. The Counsel for the applicant argues that during trial PW 1, informant has not supported the prosecution story and stated that the deceased had committed suicide on account of non-invitation Pawan Kumar Gupta S/O Late Shitla Prasad ... vs State Of U.P. Thru. Sery. Home, Lko.

entities.text: Pawan Kumar Gupta S/O Late Shitla Prasad ... vs State Of U.P. Thru. Sery. Home, Lko
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
on 19 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/37482262/
1 in the marriage of her brother.
5. Learned A.G.A. vehemently opposed the bail prayer.

6. Considering the statement of the informant recorded during trail coupled with the fact that the applicant is in custody since 25.04.2022 and has no criminal antecedents, there is nothing on record to demonstrate that the applicant if enlarged on bail, would in any way adversely affect the trial and without expressing any opinion on merit, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
7.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

8. Let the applicant Pawan Kumar Gupta be released on bail in FIR/ Case Crime No.98 of 2022,
under Sections 498A, 304-B, 201 IPC and Section 3/4 of D.P. Act, Police Station Dargah Sharif,
District Bahraich on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 19.7.2023 akverma  Pawan Kumar Gupta S/O Late Shitla Prasad ... vs State Of U.P. Thru. Sery. Home, Lko.
